bundle.shortDescription: Structured layout editor for academic research posters
bundle.longDescription: Research Poster Studio lays out A0/A1 academic posters from YAML + Markdown + BibTeX with columns, blocks and height modes, previews them at real size, warns about overflow, and exports PDF, PNG, HTML, SVG, PPTX and Markdown.
